About

MISS COSMO is a beauty pageant on the ZEPETO platform, organized by Cosmo Era Company (Vietnam 🇻🇳), with licensed organizers in 31 countries.

MCO ALLSTARS – Season 11 is a special season, open to all contestants and runners-up from other pageants, including Miss Cosmo, to shine together with a one-of-a-kind beauty – Unique Beauty.

The crane, the lotus and the Dong Son bronze drum, timeless symbols of Vietnamese culture, come together in the unique beauty of this special season.

Rules

The pageant is held entirely online on the ZEPETO app. It is open to all players and to runners-up from other pageants, including Miss Cosmo.

Your application includes: stage name, ZEPETO ID and a Google Drive link containing 2 photos (your official avatar and a front-facing avatar with the background removed). Full rules will be announced.
